name: Captured by Spiders
text: Setup: Add Spider Den to the staging area. The opposing team searches the encounter deck for one different 0 cost enemy or 0 cost location per player and adds them to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck.
back_text:
Forced: When Spider Den is explored, flip it over and put Mendor into play under the first player's control, ready.
This stage cannot be defeated unless the first player controls Mendor.

name: A Chosen Path
text: When Revealed: The opposing team searches the top 5 cards of the encounter deck for a card with cost 1 or less (cost 2 or less if there are two or more players), sets it aside, and shuffles the encounter deck. Reveal the set aside card. Its 'when revealed' effects cannot be canceled.
back_text:
The first treachery revealed each round gains Doomed 1 and its 'when revealed' effects cannot be canceled.
Forced: After characters are committed to the quest, no more than 5 progress can be placed here this round (10 progress instead if Mendor is committed to the quest).

back_text:
Each enemy in the staging area gets -10 engagement cost, cannot be optionally engaged and cannot take damage.

name: On the Trail
text: When Revealed: The opposing team searches the top 5 cards of the encounter deck for a card with cost 2 or less (cost 3 or less if there are two or more players), sets it aside, and shuffles the encounter deck. Reveal the set aside card. Its 'when revealed' effects cannot be canceled.
back_text:
When Revealed: The opposing team searches the encounter deck and discard pile for an enemy, adds it to the staging area, then places a resource on an enemy in play with cost 2 or higher. While this stage is in play, the enemy with a resource gets +2 [attack], +2 [defense], and is immune to player card effects.
This stage cannot be defeated while the enemy with a resource is in play. When this stage is defeated, the players win the game.

name: On the Trail
text: When Revealed: The opposing team searches the top 5 cards of the encounter deck for a card with cost 2 or less (cost 3 or less if there are two or more players), sets it aside, and shuffles the encounter deck. Reveal the set aside card. Its 'when revealed' effects cannot be canceled.
back_text:
X is equal to the threat level of the player with the highest threat level.
Each player's threat cannot be reduced by more than 1 each round.
Forced: After the players quest successfully, if 10 or more progress was placed here this phase, reveal the top card of the encounter deck.
If the players defeat this stage, they win the game.

back_text:
Forced: At the beginning of the quest phase, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a location is discarded. Add that location to the staging area.
If the players defeat this stage, they win the game.
